1527619714515537921 [2022-05-20] @nobu_hibiki 💜 6
Contemplating on how the base economic capacity of the majority is incredibly important in supporting a large quantity of high quality niche stuff.

It's not as if Indonesia lacks high quality niche stuff, it's just an incredibly small percentage compared to the population.

===

1527621339317563392 [2022-05-20] @nobu_hibiki 💜 1
That means u need around 2000 people to support u and your other 19 posse for 100rb per month.

That's quite the amount. Around a weeks food money for uni students.

Like, two cups of coffee for """westerners""" ($6).
↓
1527621710152732673 [2022-05-20] @nobu_hibiki 💜 1
Look rough money estimate and yadayada lots of caveats.

BUT

Rough napkin makes it sorta legible the incredibly rough economic requirement for the niche to work.

Now why did I want creator economy? Because it allows for network effect to increase exposure of the niche.
↓
1527622036704530432 [2022-05-20] @nobu_hibiki 💜 1
I think the biggest bottleneck in Indonesian niche scenes are they are usually sustained by either a patron or sustained by a player.

When all you need to convince is 1 guy there's no incentive to get the thing out there, just to be consumed by the ingroup.
↓
1527622374396338176 [2022-05-20] @nobu_hibiki 💜 2
Sure enjoyment of the ingroup is important, yes yadayadayada, but I think the competitive and "get it out there to the public" part is also important to keep the blood flowing.

If you want to make it last you must think about how to keep regenerating with new ideas.
↓
